Update September 22, 7:04 PM: Apple has now released the corresponding Release Candidate public beta, with the same build number as the second developer RC.

Less than a week after releasing macOS 26.7.1 and macOS 15.8.1 RC 1, Apple is now pushing out the second Release Candidate (RC) ahead of the official rollout. Here's what's going on.

macOS 26.7.1 and 15.8.1 second RC now available

Last week, Apple released the first Release Candidate (RC) of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1. On the same day, Apple also rolled out macOS 27.2 beta 1 instead of the macOS 27.1 beta 1 and its counterparts that most users and developers had expected.

While macOS 27.2 beta 1 added French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish support for Siri AI, the macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 betas have been relatively quiet, with Apple only noting that they "deliver important security fixes and are recommended for all users."

Apple will likely publish the associated security details in the coming weeks when it officially rolls out macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1.

The release build number for the macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 RC 2 is 25G313, while the build number for the second RC of macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 is 24H212.

Have you spotted anything new in this RC? Drop us a line in the comments.
